segments.name: Online consumer finance
segments.description: Provides online direct sales and online consumer finance services to customers in the PRC as a single operating segment.
segments.evidence: The Group engages primarily in online direct sales services and online consumer finance services for its customers in the PRC.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers and customers in the PRC pay interest, guarantee fees, insurance premiums and other charges on consumer finance loans and online direct sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Comprehensive financing costs refer to interest and fees borne by the borrower directly related to the loan business, including but not limited to loan interest, guarantee fees, and insurance premiums.
